name: franken-crew
description: Edge Linux self-healing server operator combining deterministic Go/eBPF kernel reflexes, Kiro Crew diagnostic reasoning, and Ed25519 WhatsApp approval gates.
author: FikFikk

crons.name: incident-sweep
crons.message: Claim any open P1/P2/POST_OOM incident atomically with incident_claim(claimer='franken-sentry'). Gather PSI history, cgroup_top, redacted journal_tail, process_tree, and zombie_report, classify the failure pattern with confidence and evidence_ids, and coordinate diagnosis via franken-architect (plan_submit against schema/plan.schema.json) and approved L2 execution plus 120s verify_health and postmortem_generate via franken-remediator.

crons.name: morning-digest
crons.message: Call incident_list and node_snapshot to summarize deferred P3 memory pressure warnings and 24-hour node health stability, then send one concise redacted digest (<= 700 chars) via wa_notify with severity='P3'.
